summary.en: The Colombian army air-striked the Gulf Clan gang, killing eight members, while cocaine-linked militias have begun employing Ukraine-style drones in attacks. A joint Colombian-Venezuelan border security operation was launched after a series of kidnappings. A court sentenced five former soldiers to reparations work for executions, and a Colombian accused by the United States of trafficking cocaine and supporting FARC dissidents remains under investigation. The conflict recorded 225 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den colombianske hæren utførte luftangrep mot Gulf Clan-gjengen, og drepte åtte medlemmer, mens militsgrupper med kobling til kokain har begynt å bruke droner i stil med Ukraina i angrep. En felles colombiansk-venezuelansk grenseoperasjon ble igangsatt etter en rekke kidnappinger. En domstol dømte fem tidligere soldater til erstatningsarbeid for henrettelser, og en colombianer som er anklaget av USA for narkotikasmugling og støtte til FARC-dissidenter, er fortsatt under etterforskning. Konflikten registrerte 225 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Colombian conflict
background.extract: The Colombian conflict began on May 27, 1964, and is a low-intensity asymmetric war between the government of Colombia, paramilitary groups, crime syndicates, and far-left guerrilla groups engaged in armed factional hostilities to increase their influence in Colombian territory. Some of the most important international contributors to the Colombian conflict include multinational corporations, the United States, Cuba, and the drug trafficking industry.
